get.description:
Returns a list of all Inspection Checklist Templates for a specified Project.
See [Filtering on List Actions](https://developers.procore.com/documentation/filtering-on-list-actions) for information on using the filtering capabilities provided by this endpoint.
Note: A User with read-only and above permissions to Inspections has access to this endpoint and the URL to individual templates on the web

parameters.name: filters[inspection_type_id]
parameters.description: Array of Inspection Type IDs. Return item(s) associated with the specified Inspection Type IDs.

parameters.name: filters[needs_update]
parameters.description: Boolean. Return template(s) whose configuration is in need of updates.

parameters.name: filters[response_set_id]
parameters.description: Array of Item Response Set IDs. Return list template(s) whose items are associated with the given Response Set IDs.

parameters.name: filters[trade_ids]
parameters.description: Array of Trade IDs. Returns item(s) with the specified Trade IDs.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description:
Sorts the list of Checklist Templates on the attribute given. By default the list is in ascending order. Use '-attribute' to sort in descending order.
Ex. 'sort=-trade'.

Per-Page.description: Number of items retrieved per page

Total.description: Total number of items to be retrieved

Link.description: Link headers for the first, prev, next, and last link

id.description: Unique identifier for the Inspection Checklist Template.

name.description: Name of the Inspection Checklist Template.

deletable.description: Whether the template can be deleted; false when it has ongoing schedules.

broken_config.description: Indicates whether the template has an invalid configuration because an item requirement or display condition references a response option or status that its response set does not provide. When true, update the affected items or response sets before using the template.

company_description.description: Description inherited from the company-level Checklist Template this template is synced to.

description.description: Description of the Inspection Checklist Template.

created_at.description: Represents when the Item Display Condition was created

updated_at.description: Represents when the Item Display Condition was last updated
Timestamp when this trade was last updated.

list_template_id.description: Company List Template ID that List Template is Synced to

reason.description: A human-readable code providing additional detail on the cause of the error.
A human-readable code providing additional detail on the cause of the error.
A human-readable code providing additional detail on the cause of the error.

Python3
x-code-samples.content:
import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

headers = { 'Authorization': "Bearer REPLACE_BEARER_TOKEN" }

conn.request("GET", "/rest/v1.1/projects/%7Bproject_id%7D/checklist/list_templates?page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&per_page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&filters%5Binspection_type_id%5D=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&filters%5Bneeds_update%5D=SOME_BOOLEAN_VALUE&filters%5Bresponse_set_id%5D=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&filters%5Btrade_ids%5D=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&filters%5Bquery%5D=SOME_STRING_VALUE&sort=SOME_STRING_VALUE", headers=headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))
